paper.title_en: Supermassive black hole binaries in the multi-messenger context of ground and spaceborne VLBI
paper.abstract_en: Evidence of a gravitational wave background suggests the existence of a population of sub-parsec supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs), with characteristic angular separations on the order of 1-10 $μ$as. Spaceborne extensions of Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI) and the next generation ground arrays introduce the possibility of directly imaging these SMBHBs. In this work, a binary Spectral Energy Distribution (SED) model is used to predict the detectability of SMBHBs with ground and spaceborne VLBI. We consider the Black Hole Explorer (BHEX), a proposal for a spaceborne VLBI mission, as our primary case study. We explore the detectable SMBHB parameter space and identify distinguishable binary signatures that could exist in the visibility domain. We find that for a flux-density-limited sample, ground array observations are more effective at detecting a wider region of the binary parameter space, with $M_\mathrm{tot} \gtrsim 10^9$ solar mass systems detectable out to redshift, $z=0.075$ and beyond. Conversely, inclusion of a spaceborne element such as BHEX, offering finer angular resolution ($\sim6\,μ$as) and sampling of the (u,v) plane not limited by Earth rotation synthesis, will provide significant benefits in constraining binary properties, resulting in improvements in characterisation of the separation and position angle of SMBHBs by a factor of $\sim4$. Near-future ground and/or spaceborne VLBI may achieve the first direct observation of a SMBHB, contributing significantly to multi-messenger studies of such systems with pulsar timing arrays and observations across the electromagnetic spectrum.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究亚秒差距超大质量黑洞双星（SMBHB）在下一代地基与空间VLBI下的可探测性，并与脉冲星计时阵列等多信使观测相联系，属于pta主题下的多信使研究；摘要清晰给出了SED模型、BHEX案例、参数空间与定量改进（分离度与位置角表征提升约4倍），方法描述具体，理论深度中等，新意在于将空间VLBI纳入SMBHB探测预测。
decision.title_zh: 地基与空间VLBI多信使背景下的超大质量黑洞双星
decision.abstract_zh: 引力波背景的证据暗示存在一类亚秒差距的超大质量黑洞双星（SMBHB）族群，其特征角间距约为1-10 $\mu$as。甚长基线干涉测量（VLBI）的空间扩展和下一代地基阵列使直接成像这些SMBHB成为可能。在本工作中，使用双星谱能量分布（SED）模型来预测地基与空间VLBI对SMBHB的可探测性。我们以黑洞探测器（BHEX）——一个空间VLBI任务的提案——作为主要案例研究。我们探索了可探测的SMBHB参数空间，并识别出可能存在于可见度域中的可区分双星特征。我们发现，对于通量密度受限的样本，地基阵列观测在探测更广的双星参数空间区域方面更为有效，总质量$M_\mathrm{tot} \gtrsim 10^9$太阳质量的系统可探测至红移$z=0.075$及更远。相反，纳入如BHEX这样的空间元素，可提供更精细的角分辨率（$\sim6\,\mu$as）以及不受地球自转综合限制的(u,v)平面采样，将在约束双星性质方面带来显著益处，使SMBHB的分离度和位置角的表征改善约4倍。近未来的地基和/或空间VLBI可能实现对SMBHB的首次直接观测，从而与脉冲星计时阵列以及跨电磁波段的观测一起，对此类系统的多信使研究作出重要贡献。
